A1_operator_and_target: expression reconstruction on linear CPM: sum_k(pi_ref_k * CPM_ikg), then identical frozen T0 log2(CPM+0.5) and 43-control z standardization
A2_support_rule: at least 50 mapped A2 B_CONV cells per donor stratum

bootstrap.sampling: case-control-stratified donor bootstrap with replacement; one shared draw for A0/A1/A2
bootstrap.duplicate_handling: expanded replicate rows; each sampled donor occurrence contributes once
bootstrap.interval: paired percentile 95% interval from successful replicates
bootstrap.failures: non-finite input/output, missing arm, or design rank <4; every attempt counts; no replenishment
bootstrap.stop_rule: HOLD when failures exceed 1% of 2,000 attempted replicates
bootstrap.conditioning: A2 mapping, A1 cutpoints, pi_ref, T0 and the 68-donor support set remain fixed
